description: This file defines an interface and a class related to durable objects for journaling in Orleans. The DurableNothing class implements the IDurableStateMachine interface but contains no operational logic, serving as a placeholder or retiring other durable types.

classes.name: DurableNothing
classes.description: A durable object implementing IDurableStateMachine that performs no operations, used for retiring other durable types.

methods.name: DurableNothing
methods.description: Constructor that registers this instance as a state machine with the provided manager.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: No-op implementation of resetting the state machine.

methods.name: Apply
methods.description: No-op implementation of applying a log entry to the state machine.

methods.name: AppendEntries
methods.description: No-op implementation of appending entries to the state machine.

methods.name: AppendSnapshot
methods.description: No-op implementation of appending a snapshot.

methods.name: DeepCopy
methods.description: Returns the current instance as it is, representing a deep copy.
